_criteria: Manual review of the snippets written by protocol_annotation.py (14 Nov 2026), sampleProcessingProtocol field only. sonication = sonication of the lysate or of tissue/cells (not of peptides, gel extracts, IP beads or washed precipitates). nuclease = nuclease treatment of the lysate or of the material before MS. phospho = phosphopeptide enrichment (TiO2, IMAC, Fe-NTA, Zr-IMAC, PolyMAC), not TiO2 used for peptide-RNA cross-links. sonication_false_positives: projects matched by the sonication rule but not sonicating the lysate; nuclease_confirmed / phospho_confirmed: projects whose protocol was confirmed by hand.
